data.reasoning: The package is a standard binary package with pinned checksums and no malicious code in the PKGBUILD. The disagreement was solely caused by a transient API error (HTTP 400) in the qwen model when auditing the .SRCINFO file, which is non-executable metadata. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and found them safe.
data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned 'inconclusive' because it encountered an HTTP 400 error while auditing .SRCINFO. The deepseek model successfully audited .SRCINFO and all other files, returning 'safe'.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: The audit tool should not mark the entire package as 'inconclusive' if a non-executable metadata file like .SRCINFO fails to audit due to a transient API error, especially when the executable PKGBUILD has been successfully audited and found safe.
Implement retry logic or graceful degradation for transient LLM API errors on non-critical files.
